subject.title: bundle-mcp: remote streamable-http server connects but tools never materialize for a Pi agent (2026.5.7)

question: Should this issue stay open pending a current-version streamable-http Pi-agent repro, or be treated as resolved by the related sandbox allowlist diagnosis?
rationale: Current source and related issues strongly suggest sandbox policy can produce the observed no-tools symptom, but this report's bearer-authenticated streamable-http setup and wildcard allowlist were not confirmed on current main or v2026.6.11.

options.title: Keep Open Pending Current Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until the reporter or a maintainer retries current main/latest release with the effective sandbox policy and bundle-mcp sandbox allowlist captured.

options.title: Close As Sandbox-Resolved
options.body: Close only if maintainers accept the related sandbox allowlist cluster as sufficient proof for this specific streamable-http report despite the missing current-version retry.

options.title: Split To A New Narrow Repro
options.body: Ask for a fresh issue with a minimal streamable-http server and redacted config if current main still loses tools after sandbox allowlist diagnostics pass.

recommendation.title: Keep Open Pending Current Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the reporter or a maintainer retries current main/latest release with the effective sandbox policy and bundle-mcp sandbox allowlist captured.

likelyOwner.reason: The question sits at the MCP runtime and tool-policy boundary where this owner has the strongest history signal.
